
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/halfcode/p/22356089" title="发布于 2026-08-09 23:01">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">10. Harness裁剪+Checkpointer续跑，Agent运行底座这样配</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>配套动画视频在：<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1HvMR6jECy/" rel="noopener nofollow">《10. Harness裁剪+Checkpointer续跑，Agent运行底座这样配》</a>，源代码在<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1HvMR6jECy/" rel="noopener nofollow">《评论区置顶》</a>。</p>
<p>大模型自己只会「想」和「说」，真正干活还得有人给它安排工具、约束行为、必要时再派帮手——这套围绕 Agent 转起来的运行环境，就叫 Harness，你可以把它想成 Agent 的工作台。这一节做两件事：把 Harness 裁到当前主流程需要的部分，再用 Checkpointer 让多轮对话能续上。</p>
<p><img alt="[图片]" class="eva3-bili-image lazyload" data-eva3-scoped="" data-size="286.94" data-width="2016" data-height="804" data-url="http://i0.hdslb.com/bfs/new_dyn/c39c927afa4c7c041b01006ce619514e3546912993053582.png" data-ai-gen-pic="0" data-eva-image="enhanced" data-pm-slice="0 0 []" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202608/1919157-20260809230140178-709841181.png"></p>
<p>先导入依赖。Harness 配置要用到 HarnessProfile、register_harness_profile；裁剪 TodoList 要用到 TodoListMiddleware；Checkpointer 则需要 MemorySaver：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> deepagents <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_deep_agent, HarnessProfile, register_harness_profile, GeneralPurposeSubagentProfile
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain.agents.middleware <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TodoListMiddleware
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langgraph.checkpoint.memory <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span> MemorySaver</pre>
</div>
<p>接着注册一份 Harness 配置：去掉 task、去掉 TodoList 中间件、关掉通用子代理，让 Agent 只走当前这条主流程：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>register_harness_profile(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">openai</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, HarnessProfile(
    excluded_tools</span>=frozenset({<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">task</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}),
    excluded_middleware</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">frozenset({TodoListMiddleware}),
    general_purpose_subagent</span>=GeneralPurposeSubagentProfile(enabled=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">False),
))</span></pre>
</div>
<p>创建 Agent 时再传入 checkpointer=MemorySaver()，多轮对话才能按 thread_id 接上：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_deep_agent(
    backend</span>=LocalShellBackend(root_dir=os.getcwd(), virtual_mode=True, inherit_env=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">True),
    checkpointer</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">MemorySaver(),
    debug</span>=True)</pre>
</div>
<p>验证续跑时，先写好会话配置：thread_id 用来标识这一条对话线程，后面的 invoke 都传同一份 configurable，Checkpointer 才知道要把多轮对话记在同一条会话里。</p>
<p>第一次提问让 Agent 记住暗号，并加上 config 参数；第二次用同一个 thread_id 问刚才记住的暗号是什么。两次会话接得上，第二次应能答上来：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> main():
    agent </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> create_test_agent()
    cfg </span>= {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">configurable</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">thread_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">checkpoint10</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}}
    result </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> agent.invoke({
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">messages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: [{<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">请记住一个暗号：LAOCHEN。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">只回复：已记住暗号。不要执行工具。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}]
    }, config</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">cfg)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(result[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">messages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>][-1].content[0][<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">text</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">])
    result </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> agent.invoke({
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">messages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: [{<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">我刚才让你记住的暗号是什么？</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>
                                                 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">只回答暗号本身，不要执行工具。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}]
    }, config</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">cfg)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(result[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">messages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>][-1].content[0][<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">text</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>])</pre>
</div>
<p>第二次能答出 LAOCHEN，说明 Checkpointer 已经把同一 thread_id 下的上下文续上了。Harness 裁干净、会话能续跑，Agent 的运行底座就算配到位了。</p>
<p>&nbsp;配套动画视频在：<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1HvMR6jECy/" rel="noopener nofollow">《10. Harness裁剪+Checkpointer续跑，Agent运行底座这样配》</a>，源代码在<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1HvMR6jECy/" rel="noopener nofollow">《评论区置顶》</a>。</p>

</div>
